info.name: Data AVAX Supply Data API Usage Metrics API
Get usage metrics for the Data API

params.name: orgId
params.description: Organization ID to fetch usage metrics for

params.name: startTimestamp
params.description: The start time of the range as a UNIX timestamp. The requested start time  will be rounded down to 0:00 UTC of the day.

params.name: endTimestamp
params.description: The end time of the range as a UNIX timestamp. The requested end time will be rounded down to 0:00 UTC of the day.

params.name: timeInterval
params.description: Time interval granularity for data aggregation

params.name: groupBy
params.description: Query param for the criterion used for grouping metrics

params.name: chainId
params.description: Filter data by chain ID.

params.name: responseCode
params.description: Filter data by response status code.

params.name: requestType
params.description: Filter data by request type.

params.name: apiKeyId
params.description: Filter data by API key ID.

params.name: requestPath
params.description: Filter data by request path.

items.docs: Gets metrics for Data API usage over a specified time interval aggregated at the specified time-duration granularity.

info.name: Get usage metrics for the Primary Network RPC

params.name: timeInterval
params.description:
Time interval granularity for data aggregation for subnet
     rpc metrics

params.name: startTimestamp
params.description: The start time of the range as a UNIX timestamp. The requested start time  will be rounded down to 0:00 UTC of the day.

params.name: endTimestamp
params.description: The end time of the range as a UNIX timestamp. The requested end time will be rounded down to 0:00 UTC of the day.

params.name: groupBy
params.description: Query param for the criterion used for grouping metrics

params.name: responseCode
params.description: Filter data by response status code.

params.name: requestPath
params.description: Filter data by request path.

params.name: country
params.description: Filter data by Country. Input must be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. "XX" - Represents clients without country code data. "T1" - Represents clients using the Tor network.

params.name: continent
params.description: Filter data by Continent. Input must be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 continent code.

params.name: userAgent
params.description: Filter data by User Agent.

params.name: rpcMethod
params.description: Filter data by RPC method.

params.name: network
params.description: Either mainnet or testnet/fuji.

items.docs: Gets metrics for public Primary Network RPC usage over  a specified time interval aggregated at the specified  time-duration granularity.
